postgame.what_decided_it: Cincinnati was efficient and clean in Madrid. 7.1 yards per play, 6 of 10 on third down, zero turnovers, 3 of 4 in the red zone. Atlanta ran well at 6.5 a carry but threw for only 162 and took 12 penalties for 88 yards.
standouts: Joe Burrow: 24/29, 271 yards, 3 TD, 0 INT. Nothing wasted.
Tee Higgins: 5 catches for only 32 yards but two touchdowns.
postgame.division_meaning: Pittsburgh sits 6-2 on a four game win streak, Cincinnati 5-2 in the table and winners of three, with the best differential in the division at +48. Cleveland 5-3, Baltimore 4-5 and losers of four.
postgame.the_take: The run game is the quiet part of this. 123 yards on 24 carries at 5.1 a pop meant Burrow never had to force anything. Do that against Pittsburgh and the North shifts.
